podcast.body: The song featured on Side Two of Elvis Presley's first-ever recording. This recording was made on July 18, 1953, when Presley, then a young truck driver, dropped into Sun Studios in Memphis to record a song as a birthday present for his mother. "Side one feature to song called That's When Your Heart It Begins and on the other, My Happiness."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This unique acetate recording was originally made by Elvis Presley as a birthday present for his mother. This specific acetate played a pivotal role in his discovery by Sam Phillips and is considered a foundational record in the history of rock and roll. The sole copy was purchased by Jack White in 2015 for $300,000. "This acetate, which is another name for it, is My Happiness by Elvis Presley."
